## Key facts

- Plain Fruit of the Loom T-shirts are sold by Marmalade Co. (marmaladeco.com) from 1 piece: €6.95, from 5 pieces €6.26 (10 % quantity discount, 5 % from 3). Prices incl. VAT, checked September 2026.
- Marmalade Co. delivers with DHL for €7 flat to Ireland, Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal and Spain in about 2 to 3 working days. It does not currently deliver to the United Kingdom.

## Colours

- [Plain black T-shirts: fading, washing and what to buy](https://plaintshirtsuk.com/plain-black-t-shirts): Why plain black T-shirts fade and 6 washing habits that keep them dark: inside out, cold wash, no hot dryer. Plus black tees from €6.26 each.
- [Plain white T-shirts: opacity, fit and keeping them white](https://plaintshirtsuk.com/plain-white-t-shirts): How to pick a plain white T-shirt that is not see-through and stays white: gsm, washing at 30 to 40 degrees and 5 habits. Tees from €6.26 each.
